message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "verify_image_modality_before_tool_selection", "description": "When the provided medical image modality does not match the input requirements of available diagnostic tools, skip those tools and rely on direct visual analysis or state the mismatch.", "applicable_conditions": "The input includes a medical image (e.g., CT, MRI, Ultrasound) but the available automated tools are strictly designed for a different modality (e.g., Chest X-Ray only).", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["differential_diagnosis"], "required_tools": [], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the input image modality (e.g., CT, MRI) contradicts the specific input requirements of available tools (e.g., chest_xray_classifier requires CXR): (1) Do NOT attempt to use the incompatible tools; (2) Rely on direct visual interpretation of the original image if accessible; (3) Explicitly document the modality mismatch as the reason for skipping tool usage in the reasoning trace."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
